title: Fixed Low Deck and T Stem Kick Scooter
description: One newly authored complete static unpowered kick-scooter exterior. A low long narrow foot deck continues into two integral rear axle prongs around a small rear wheel and a rising front neck that seats a real open cylindrical steering head. A long thin T mast, separate front fork crown and paired legs, two full annular small tires with hubs/axles, two thick handle grips, a complete curved rear fender-brake appearance, and a deployed narrow stand form one integrated whole vehicle. The head tube retains a real annular opening around its narrower fixed stem. No old electric step-through body is stripped: all geometry is new, with no saddle, broad leg shield or motor housing. Unlike the old skateboard there are no transverse paired-wheel trucks or double-kick concave deck. Three opaque untextured PBR roles, metres, ground-centred envelope, one prop and zero scenes. Fixed display only; no steering, braking, folding, riding suitability, load, road compliance, material or safety performance claim. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
